meta.name: golden_registers
meta.description: 231 (stage D, D-d5): the invented outside registers a case's lookups ask in the tests and the trial (jav/devtools/invented_services.py, a local service on this machine; the connectors invented_company_register and invented_sanctions_list). companies: the company register by tax number (name, activity code, status). sanctions: the sanctions list's entries (a name, a tax number or both); an entry matches a question by its tax number, or by its name written the same way (case, spaces and punctuation aside). Every name and number is invented; the tax numbers are on the data guard's list of invented values.

changelog.note: 231 (D-d5): the first version: three companies (one under liquidation) and two sanctions entries (one by tax number, one by name only).
